name: Qwen-Image 2512
desc: The non-anime path. Photoreal and general illustration, driven by prose rather than tags.
prompt_style: natural language prose, a sentence describing the scene
note: Authored because 52 of the 64 style cards route here and the checkpoints library described only the two anime SDXLs - a styles consumer resolving engine->checkpoint would have found nothing. Two measured facts that change how you use it: with the 4-step Lightning LoRA it runs at cfg 1.0 in ~4.5s, and AT THAT SETTING THE NEGATIVE PROMPT IS NEARLY IGNORED - inherent to CFG-distilled models. Negatives only bite if you drop the LoRA and run 20 steps at cfg 2.5-4.0. Also: past about 2 MP it duplicates composition (two horizons, repeated subjects), so generate at 1-2 MP and upscale 4x.
